display.purpose: Brand, section headings, tab labels, recipe names. Lilita One 400, self-hosted OFL.

body.purpose: All functional text on paper. Karla variable 200-800, self-hosted OFL.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Cream panels floating over the red ground.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons on hover, with translateY(-1px).

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Single authored moment: tab panel entrance (opacity + 10px rise), disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on cream panels: pill, Rouge Service, Label typography.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--red-btn); color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.92rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(46,6,8,0.3); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--red-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(46,6,8,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and destructive actions: transparent pill with a 1.5px border that fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 0.45rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink-soft); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--paper-soft); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard field on paper: sandy border, gold focus ring, red caret.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper-input); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; caret-color: var(--red-btn); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7A5F4A; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(232,160,32,0.3); outline: none; }

components.name: Folder Tabs
components.description: Section navigation on the red ground; the active tab turns paper and merges into the panel.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Sélection de recettes</button><button class="ds-tab">Liste de courses</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; background: rgba(46,6,8,0.38); color: #F3D9B0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(46,6,8,0.55); color: var(--paper); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--paper); color: var(--red-deep); box-shadow: 0 -6px 14px rgba(46,6,8,0.18); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Menu Panel
components.description: The cream work surface every tab opens onto; heading closed by a double gold rule.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 0 12px 12px 12px; padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem 1.6rem; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(46,6,8,0.4); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.55rem; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: var(--red-deep); border-bottom: 4px double var(--gold); padding-bottom: 0.35rem; }

components.name: Menu Line
components.description: Signature recipe entry: display name, dotted leader, portion count on the right.
components.css: .ds-menu-line { position: relative; padding: 0.9rem 0 1rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-soft); } .ds-menu-line::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2.05rem; left: 0; right: 0; border-top: 2px dotted rgba(107,84,69,0.45); } .ds-menu-line > strong { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: var(--paper); padding-right: 0.55rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: var(--red-deep); } .ds-menu-line > .ds-servings { float: right; position: relative; background: var(--paper); padding-left: 0.55rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Ingredient Chip
components.description: Gold-soft pill for ingredient tags and selectable step ingredients.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: var(--gold-soft); border: 1px solid var(--gold-line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Recipe Picker is a vibrant restaurant menu you cook from: a saturated red room, cream menu paper, dark brown ink, mustard-gold service marks. The world reaches the screen through type, palette, density, and one signature move — the dotted-leader menu line — never through re-invented controls.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated red page ground with a warm top glow and a darker foot
Cream menu-paper panels carrying all work surfaces
Lilita One display lettering over a Karla text face
Dotted-leader menu lines as the recipe list's signature
Mustard gold reserved for service marks: rules, selection, badges, focus

rules.name: The Red Is the Room Rule
rules.body: The red ground owns everything outside the panels; panels never turn gray or white-neutral — the paper is always cream.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Waiter Rule
rules.body: Gold serves; it never speaks paragraphs. It appears as rules, rings, chips, and badges, always with dark ink when it carries text.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display lettering speaks names and sections; Karla speaks everything actionable.

rules.name: The Soft Landing Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries an offset and a blur in the red-dark hue; a zero-blur block shadow never ships.

dos: Do keep every work surface on cream paper over the red ground.
Do write headings in Lilita One and close them with the 4px double gold rule.
Do reserve gold for rules, selection, badges, and focus — always with dark ink when it carries text.
Do tint secondary text from the brown ink (#6B5445), never neutral gray.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette (selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, accent-color).
donts: Don't put neutral white or gray panels on the red ground — paper is cream or it isn't this design.
Don't use gold as body-text color on cream (fails contrast; gold is a mark, not a voice).
Don't ship hard offset block shadows or solid hairline separators — shadows are soft, separators are dashed or dotted.
Don't re-invent controls in the menu's image: tabs, inputs, and buttons stay standard and scannable; the world lives in type, palette, density, and the dotted leader.
